jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

Dandy is hiring an Operations Manager to design, scale, and optimize the systems that power our manufacturing network. This role sits on our central Strategy Operations team and is focused on ensuring every order ships on time by building scalable solutions that optimize labor, equipment, and system orchestration. You’ll be responsible for creating the infrastructure to assign 100% of labor, achieve 100% OEE visibility on the floor, ensure 100% of orders and labor are scheduled through our system, and enable 24/7 machine utilization through demand smoothing strategies.

You will work cross-functionally with Data, Product, and Operations leaders to translate business needs into system requirements, and then partner to design, launch, and optimize the architecture that drives execution. This is a high-impact role that will unlock scale, predictability, and efficiency in our manufacturing operations.

What You'll Do

 - Build scalable systems: Design and roll out solutions to fully allocate labor, track OEE, and ensure all orders and labor are scheduled by system logic.

 - Drive on-time delivery: Implement strategies and tools that ensure every order is scheduled, resourced, and delivered on time.

 - Own architecture & strategy: Partner with Product and Data to define system requirements, align on architecture decisions, and roll out enhancements.

 - Ensure visibility & accountability: Lead dashboard builds of real-time insights that connect labor, equipment utilization, and scheduling performance to business outcomes.

 - Operationalize improvements: Diagnose bottlenecks, design solutions, and lead pilots/rollouts to close gaps.

 - Cross-functional leadership: Act as the connective tissue between Strategy Operations, Product, Data, and Manufacturing, ensuring system architecture reflects operational realities and future scale needs.

What We're Looking For

 - 6+ years in operations, manufacturing, or systems-focused roles (consulting, strategy, or product ops experience a plus).

 - Strong program/project management skills with experience delivering cross-functional system rollouts.

 - Experience designing and implementing systems for scale (ERP/MES, scheduling, resource allocation).

 - Data-driven problem solver

 - Strong communicator who can translate operational needs into system requirements and influence cross-functional partners.

 - Self-starter with high ownership, detail orientation, and ability to drive clarity in ambiguous environments.

 - Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Business or closely related field.

Bonus Points For:

 - Outstanding professional references to share

 - Strong verbal and written communication skills with ability to present quantitative concepts

 - Comfortable using SQL, Looker, or similar tools to build visibility and drive decisions.

 - Experience with marketplace business models

 - Management consulting or investment banking backgrounds, extra bonus points for startup experience

 - Willingness to roll up your sleeves and fix problems in a hands-on manner when needed

 - Relentlessly positive attitude, strong sense of humor, and the ability to have fun at work

 - Willingness/Availability to travel to U.S. Monthly.

We're hiring a Sales Manager to lead our Emerging Enterprise (EEnt) team — the reps responsible for winning multi-location dental groups and emerging DSOs in the 4–9 location range. Reporting to the Head of Emerging Enterprise, you'll lead a team of experienced, quota-carrying Account Executives running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

This is the newest team inside Dandy's fastest-growing business segment, which means the playbook isn't fully baked yet. You'll have real latitude to create, build, and develop: the processes, the enablement, and most importantly the talent. If you want a seat where your fingerprints are on how a team operates rather than inheriting someone else's system, this is it.



What You'll Do

 - Own the strategy, structure, and quota performance of the EEnt team, including territory design, account prioritization, and outbound motion into multi-location groups

 - Sell alongside, coach, and develop a team of senior Account Executives — and build the ramp, career path, and performance bar that scales beyond your first cohort

 - Build the team playbook from the ground up: discovery frameworks for multi-location decision committees, business-case and ROI models, mutual action plans, pilot-to-rollout expansion paths, and competitive positioning against national labs and chairside milling

 - Coach to deal strategy, not just activity:  pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecast accuracy, and multi-threading discipline

 - Lead by example: engage directly in your team's most strategic opportunities, running exec-level conversations and helping navigate to close

 - Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Enterprise Onboarding/CS, Clinical, and Lab Operations to land accounts that scan, order, and expand across every location

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Finance Operations
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Manager, Finance Operations to lead accounts payable and billing and collections as one function. You'll own procure-to-pay and order-to-cash from end to end, with teams across the US, the Philippines and Colombia.

This is an accounting-led role. AP and AR sit at the start of our financial data. When an invoice gets paid without a PO, or a bill goes out at the wrong price, the problem lands in the general ledger weeks later. We want a leader who understands the accounting impact of every transaction and builds controls to get the data right at the source.

Dandy runs high-volume physical operations: two US manufacturing labs, dental practice and DSO customers in several countries, a large vendor base and multiple legal entities. You'll bring accounting rigor and scale to the teams behind every dollar in and out.

What you'll do

Accounts Payable

 - Own the full procure-to-pay cycle: vendor setup, invoice processing, PO matching, approvals and payment runs.

 - Enforce PO compliance and three-way match with Procurement and Operations.

 - Manage domestic and international vendor payments across entities and currencies, in partnership with Treasury.

 - Own vendor master data quality and 1099 reporting.

Billing and Collectinos

 - Own billing accuracy, credit controls and pricing controls across practice and DSO accounts.

 - Run cash application and collections, including a clear process for large DSO accounts agreed with Account Management.

 - Support the bad debt reserve with aging analysis and collection forecasts.

Controls and Close

 - Design and document controls over procure-to-pay and order-to-cash, including segregation of duties, built to public company audit standards.

 - Deliver AP and AR subledger reconciliations, accruals and cut-off on the close calendar.

 - Serve as the main contact for auditors on AP and AR testing.

Team and Systems

 - Lead the AP and billing and collections teams, including managers and team leads, with clear SOPs, training and quality checks.

 - Automate invoice capture, approvals and collections workflows in NetSuite and related tools.

 - Set and report on core metrics: DSO, aged receivables, PO match rate, payment accuracy and cost per transaction.

What success looks like in year one

 - Every invoice paid against an approved PO or a documented exception.

 - A working collections process for aged receivables and a lower DSO.

 - AP and AR reconciliations complete early in the close, with no audit adjustments.

 - Documented SOPs and controls for every core AP and AR process.

What we're looking for

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

 - 8+ years of experience, including general ledger or public accounting, and 3+ years leading AP, AR or finance shared services.

 - Hands-on knowledge of how AP and AR transactions hit the general ledger, accruals and revenue.

 - Experience in an operational business with high transaction volume: manufacturing, distribution, healthcare services or logistics.

 - Experience leading offshore or BPO teams across time zones.

 - A track record of building controls and passing audits, ideally under SOX or PCAOB standards.

 - Multi-entity and multi-currency experience.

 - Advanced Excel and strong NetSuite or comparable ERP skills.

 - A builder mindset: you fix the process, document the fix and train the team.

Bonus Points

 - CPA preferred. 

 - AP automation or billing system implementation experience.

 - Healthcare, dental or medical device industry experience.

 - High-volume B2B or usage-based billing experience.

 - Spanish language skills.
